svg.title: Aryan Raj — AI & ML Engineer, Flutter & Full-Stack Developer

g.text: B.Tech · Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning · 4th Year
AI-powered apps · Flutter · Open Source · Modern UI/UX · Backend APIs
Technology is just a tool. I don't limit myself to a single stack — I learn what's needed to
solve the problem. I've built multiple web and mobile applications, often exploring new
technologies throughout the development process. My goal isn't to master every framework,
but to build products that solve real problems. If I can imagine it, I can build it.
